work.author: Joseph Braun, S.J. (1857-1947)
work.description: Braun's illustrated study of the origin, development, use, construction, and symbolism of Western and Eastern liturgical vesture. Its stable loci are printed pages and named vestment chapters. It is historical and material-culture scholarship rather than an official Roman liturgical book.
